Description: Audio Scene Delivery: renders an Audio Scene to a device - headphones, loudspeakers, a dome. Accepts either kind of scene, Basic or full, on its own Port. Its output is HARDWARE and its consumer is the LISTENER, not the User Agent: the Audio Scene Descriptors reach the User Agent directly from CAE-ASE without crossing this AIM, because they are data flowing back into a control loop while this is a rendering leaving the system for a human ear. That difference of consumer, more than the device, is why acquisition and delivery are AIMs in CAE-ASM and User Agent modules in MMC-AMQ and MMC-TST.
